product_brief: Application delivery controller with PQC readiness, AI workload security, and modernized TMOS software.
pqc_capability_description: BIG-IP v21.1 supports hybrid key exchange X25519_ML-KEM-768 in TLS 1.3. It adds NIST-compliant PQC cipher groups SecP256r1ML-KEM-768 and SecP384r1ML-KEM-1024 for client/server connections and SSL Forward Proxy. BIG-IP Zero Trust Access v21.1 introduces quantum-resistant TLS/SSL VPN tunneling with X25519 + ML-KEM-768.
crypto_primitives: X25519, ML-KEM-768, SecP256r1, SecP384r1, ML-KEM-1024, RSA, ECC
key_management_model: Hybrid cryptography combining traditional methods (SecP) with quantum resistant algorithms (ML-KEM); certificate-based auth implied by SSL Forward Proxy and TLS/SSL VPN context.
architecture_type: Application Delivery Controller (ADC), inline encryptor, proxy
fips_validated: No (Text states ciphers "align to FIPS 203 standards" and help ensure compliance, but does not state the product itself is FIPS validated)
pqc_roadmap_details: BIG-IP Zero Trust Access is expected to add quantum-secure IPSec tunneling support in the not-too-distant future.
